glosses: The smallest possible amount, quantity, or degree.
Among elements of some collection, such that no other element is greater (with respect to some given partial order).

examples.text: With respect to the ordering induced by set-theoretic inclusion, the power set of the set of natural numbers has a unique minimal element: the empty set.

glosses: Characterised by the use of simple form or structures.

Something very small; a tiny part or fragment.
